mapper.select: select c.rent_id, c.project_id, c.cashflow_id, c.receivable_date, (@i :=@i + 1) AS seq_number from CON_CONTRACT_BEFORE_RENT_H c,(SELECT @i := 0) AS row_seq where c.project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT * FROM con_contract_before_rent_h ccbr WHERE ccbr.project_id = #{projectId} and ccbr.company_id = #{companyId} and ccbr.zero_time_flag = 'N' order by ccbr.receivable_date asc
SELECT * FROM con_contract_before_rent_h ccbr WHERE ccbr.project_id = #{projectId} and ccbr.company_id = #{companyId} and ccbr.zero_time_flag = 'N' order by ccbr.receivable_date desc
mapper.delete: delete from con_contract_before_rent_h t where t.receivable_date>#{inceptOfLease} and t.project_Id=#{projectId}
